preconditions.expression: isinstance(stdin, str) and 0 < len(stdin) <= 10**5 and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: stdin is a non-empty string of length at most 10^5, containing only lowercase Latin letters and digits.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum(count * (count - 1) for count in Counter(stdin).values()))
postconditions.description: stdout is the total number of ordered pairs (i, j) where 1 ≤ i, j ≤ N and S[i] == S[j], computed as the sum over all characters of (count choose 2) * 2, where count is the frequency of that character in stdin.
